newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos falls after disappointing result.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos falls after disappointing result.

text.p: Food-based Cerebos Pacific Ltd shed Singapore $0.55 or 6.88 percent to S$7.45 in early trade on Wednesday after posting below-expectation financial results for the six months ended March 31, and warning of a tougher second half.
At 0135 GMT, volume was about 40,000 shares.

On Tuesday, the group, which sells Brand's Essence of Chicken among other products, reported flat net profit of S$47.01 million and weaker sales of S$338.10 million for the first-half of its fiscal year.
It said the lower turnover was due to economic slowdowns in Asia, tight credit conditions in China and the termination of a distribution agreement for a product line in Australia.
